description: A Chrome extension for tracking daily goals with timers, counters, and checkboxes. See FEATURES.md for full specifications.

userStories.title: Make Add New Goal screen compact with smart category layout
userStories.description: Make the Add New Goal screen compact and tightly wound. Categories should use smart flex layout to fit optimally in one row (e.g., 5 items in one row instead of 4+1). Make the overall layout more space-efficient.

userStories.title: Use compact buttons on Add New Goal screen
userStories.description: Replace large buttons with more compact alternatives throughout the Add New Goal screen to reduce visual bulk and improve the tight layout.

userStories.title: Fix Target Count field layout
userStories.description: The Target Count input field is not taking the full row width and appears to be floating in empty space. Fix the layout so it properly fills its container.

userStories.title: Make Settings screen more compact
userStories.description: Make the Settings screen more compact, particularly the reset times section, i like the current skeleton but just Reduce spacing and make better use of available space.

userStories.title: Clean up context menu options
userStories.description: Remove the 'Start Timer' option from the right-click context menu as it has no use. Also, hide the 'Timer Floater' option if the floater is already injected and visible on the page.

userStories.title: Make Reports page compact
userStories.description: Make the Reports page more compact by reducing spacing and making better use of available space.

userStories.title: Add Reset option in Settings
userStories.description: Add a Reset button beside Export/Import in Settings that clears all extension storage, states, and data. Should include a confirmation dialog to prevent accidental resets.

userStories.title: Split Settings into Normal and Advanced sections
userStories.description: Split the Settings screen into two sections: Normal (always visible) and Advanced (hidden by default, revealed via dropdown/expandable section). The search functionality should work across both sections and show matching results regardless of which section they belong to.
